content.thinking: Attempt 0 was rejected with "Null TopoDS_Shape" — likely an OCC failure, possibly a feature extending below Z=0? Side puff lowest Z: center 6, size 7, tilt -25° about X increases Z extent... lowest Z maybe near 6-3.5·cos... should be fine. The rejection could be from rotation causing geometry issues. Safer: reduce rotations, keep simple. Also center puff lowest Z: 5.5 - half-height 5.5 with tilt -15° → could dip below 0? Half-extent along Z after 15° tilt: half of 11 = 5.5; tilted extent = sqrt((5.5cos15)^2+(2.5? no, X half 8)) ... Z extent = 5.5·cos15 + 8·sin15 = 5.31+2.07=7.38 → lowest Z = 5.5-7.38 = -1.88 <0! That's below Z=0 → rejection. Fix: raise center or reduce tilt. Use center z=7, base 3 thick, lowest Z = 7-7.38 = -0.38 still negative. Reduce tilt to -10°: Z extent = 5.5·cos10+8·sin10 = 5.42+1.39=6.81; center 7 → lowest 0.19 >0 but must be < base thickness 3 and overlap: 0.19 <3 ✓. Side puff: size 10x6x7, tilt -25,-20,10. Z half-extent ~ 3.5cos25+3sin25+... ≈ 3.17+1.27+ small = ~4.6; center 6 → lowest ~1.4 <3 ✓, and overlap in XY with base (Y=4, base half Y=8) ✓. Front small puff [4,3,4.5] size 7x5x5 rotated 20,15: Z extent ≈ 2.5cos20+3.5cos15... ~2.35+3.38·? compute roughly: 2.5cos20 + 3.5sin? Let's just keep center 5, tilt small 10,0: extent ~2.5cos10+? fine, lowest ≈5-3.1=1.9<3 ✓.
